Maya: quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today
Maya: Did: finished kv-evict telemetry fix, rolled patch to canary.
Maya: Blocker: seeing 2% spike in 503s on batcher when seq_len>1024, need repro logs.
Maya: Today: triage repro, add extra logging, coordinate with @Aj for rollout.
Aj: saw the 503s earlier, I left a debug build on eu-west-1; logs at https://console.internal/redwood/logs/abc123 :mag:
Aj: pinged deploy-bot to roll back if error rate > 1.5% [cc @Natalie]
Oncall-bot: ALERT (sev3) normalized: batcher-503-rate in eu-west spiked to 2.1% at 10:23 UTC. Link: https://alerts.redwood/incoming/12345
Liam: PR #2894 adds a guard for seq_len, will drop into canary after smoke. cc @Natalie
Natalie: I'm oncall rollover in 2h — if you need me for a rollback ping me via DM. :raised_hands:
Maya: thanks. If rollback needed, run: `deploy rollback batcher canary`
Aj: quick ask — can we add a short-lived metric for kv-cache hit ratio? I can wire it.
Liam: yes, add metric name `kv_cache_short_hit_ratio` and tag `seq_len_bucket`.
Maya: I'll put a small eval prompt in the dashboard so we can correlate latency vs seq_len.
Aj: opened a small PR to adjust alert threshold: `if rate > 1.5% for 5m` -> https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/456 #patch
Natalie: noted. I'll update runbook step 3 to call out `kv-evict` rollback path. https://runbooks.internal/redwood/kv-evict
Maya: no blockers otherwise. leaving logs and a packet capture in /tmp/batcher-dump.tgz
Liam: LGTM on PR, will merge once CI passes. If CI flakes, will restart with `bazel test //...`
Maya: thanks team. closing loop later with postmortem if persists. :thumbsup:
